title: Affine-local characterization of flat families with geometric complete-intersection fibres
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For a field $k$, say a scheme locally of finite type over $k$ is a local complete intersection over $k$ if it has an affine open cover by spectra of finitely generated $k$-algebras which are local complete intersections in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]; the empty scheme is allowed. The following conditions are equivalent. (1) The morphism $f$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ and geometric point $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ [def-weil-geometric-point] its geometric fibre, the fibre product $X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-pc-fibre-product] [def-weil-geometric-fibre], is a local complete intersection over $\Omega$. (2) For every affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq Y$ and every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq X$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$, the induced map $A\to B$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], and for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset A$ the fibre ring $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a local complete intersection over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$. (3) There exist an affine open cover $Y=\bigcup_a V_a$, $V_a=\operatorname{Spec}A_a$, and for each $a$ an affine open cover $f^{-1}(V_a)=\bigcup_b U_{ab}$, $U_{ab}=\operatorname{Spec}B_{ab}$, such that each induced map $A_a\to B_{ab}$ is flat and of finite presentation and every fibre ring $B_{ab}\otimes_{A_a}\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is a local complete intersection over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset A_a$.

source.place: Tag 01UD (lemma-syntomic-characterize), conditions (1), (2), (4); Tag 01UC (definition-syntomic); Tag 01UE (lemma-syntomic-locally-standard-syntomic) and Tag 01UF (lemma-syntomic-flat-fibres). Ring syntomicity is precisely the three written ring conditions by Algebra Tag 00SL (definition-lci). The geometric-fibre formulation uses Algebra Tag 00SJ (lemma-lci-field-change), algebra.tex, and Morphisms lemma-local-complete-intersection.
